We, at Sameer Exports, have fully equipped manufacturing facilities together 
    with state-of-the-art machines and equipments. We use traditional sand castings 
    and our products are partially mechanised and partially handcrafted. The latest 
    forging machines are installed for hot stamped, high density, non porous and 
    high quality products. Finishing, polishing, lacquering and packaging facilities 
    conform to the international standards and buyers requirements.

The company incorporates innovative ideas and creativity in design and production 
    processes. This ensures that products are functionally elegant and aesthetically 
    satisfying to come up to the international competition. They are offered at 
    the most competitive prices. With a constant focus on total customer satisfaction 
    and on-schedule delivery of products, Sameer Exports, undertakes strict quality 
    control programs to ensure reliability of its esteemed customers.

The company has been able to gain immense popularity due to its attractive 
    product range. It has numerous international clients spread across countries 
    like: Germany and Australia.
